description:
EmbeddingDenseBackward: Computes the gradient for an embedding layer with dense backward pass.

torch.ops.aten.embedding_dense_backward(grad_output, indices, num_weights, padding_idx, scale_grad_by_freq) -> Tensor

Performs the backward pass for torch.nn.functional.embedding. Given the gradient of the output (grad_output) and the indices used in the forward pass, computes the gradient with respect to the embedding weights.

Args:
    grad_output (Tensor): Gradient of the output, shape [*, hidden_dim].
    indices (Tensor): The indices tensor from forward pass, shape [*].
    num_weights (int): Number of rows in the embedding weight matrix.
    padding_idx (int, optional): Index of padding token whose gradient is zeroed out. Default: -1.
    scale_grad_by_freq (bool, optional): Whether to scale gradients by the inverse frequency of each index. Default: False.

Returns: Tensor of shape [num_weights, hidden_dim], same dtype as grad_output.
